<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="lava-strykewyrms" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Lava Strykewyrms</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>After the Wilderness Update, killing Lava Strykewyrms has become substantially safer. Despite that, their drops are still highly valued mainly due to Searing Ashes being the main ingredient for Aggression Potions </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 1872</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~520 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, 450 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour : ~973K </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, 842K </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Lava Strykewyrms have a valuable loot table containing: Searing Ashes, Onyx Bolts (e), Rune salvage, coins and potions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This makes them one of the better tasks to do for gp.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Lava Strykewyrms also drop the Wyrm Spike </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150743982723143.png?v=1" alt="wyrmspike" title="wyrmspike" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Wyrm Heart </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150746721603625.png?v=1" alt="wyrmheart" title="wyrmheart" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Wyrm Scalp </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150749091381248.png?v=1" alt="wyrmscalp" title="wyrmscalp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at a rate of 1/6168 on task (1/12,288 off task), which are required for the Wilderness Slayer collection log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and how to get there</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They are located South of the Lava Maze (level 34-41 wilderness).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The quickest way to get there is via the obelisk teleport to the level 35 obelisk.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-items-and-unlocks"><nowiki>Useful Items and Unlocks</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Wilderness_sword_4 <strong><nowiki>Wilderness sword 4</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1009419838764109834.png?v=1" alt="wildernesssword" title="wildernesssword" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Automatically notes ashes when carried in the inventory.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Headhunter's_thrill <strong><nowiki>Headhunter's thrill</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1134960074608095252.png?v=1" alt="headhuntersthrill" title="headhuntersthrill" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Since lava strykes cannot be poisoned, there is no glove slot that significantly increases kph. Thus, these can be used for longer tasks.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Quest_Cape <strong><nowiki>Portable fairy ring/Quest cape</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091050888828813412.png?v=1" alt="masterquestcape" title="masterquestcape" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Provides a fast teleport to the Glacor cavern for the Stone of Jas buff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Portable_obelisk <strong><nowiki>Portable obelisk/Obelisk shard</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki>
    • Used to teleport to the level 35 Obelisk, the fastest way to get to lava strykewyrms.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Passive unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Premier_artefact <strong><nowiki>Premier Artefact</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/918517285176623104.png?v=1" alt="premierartefact" title="premierartefact" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Can be used for longer tasks.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) <strong><nowiki>Stone of Jas buff</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Provides a 4% damage increase against lava strykewyrms.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box <strong><nowiki>Infernal Puzzle box</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Provides a 9% damage increase and 14% damage reduction in the wilderness at max rank.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Mobile <strong><nowiki>Mobile</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> perk on armour
    • Lava strykes are spaced out and spawn moderately slowly. You will need to use movement abilities frequently while waiting for spawns.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-strategy"><ins><nowiki>General strategy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Place your cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> between the 2 small lava pits as shown below. You will alternate between killing the strykes northwest and southeast of this spot, most of which can be hit by the cannon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/LTV5mCPKc0.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-magic"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active Magic</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This method is can be done with low effort, only requiring the player to click on each spawn and letting Revo++ kill them (~250 KPH), or with high effort, using both dual-wield and 2H weapons and full manual (~450 KPH).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If 4TAA, stamp on mounds with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/694566917553520680.png?v=1" alt="inquisitorstaff" title="inquisitorstaff" kind="icon" /><nowiki> equipped and input the auto when you see your character do the stomp animation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="preset"><nowiki>Preset</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=hkE9wpk2HmcXTeGsfxPD <nowiki>Active Magic</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FhkE9wpk2HmcXTeGsfxPD.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="action-bar"><nowiki>Action Bar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Use this bar if doing the task low effort, shift </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to last slot if not on task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/T8NBimA.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="video-example"><nowiki>Video example</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/Ammu3M_H1U0 <nowiki>Active Mage</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-ranged"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active Ranged</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>If </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is owned, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is the best style for killing lava strykewyrms due to its high damage, range and mobility.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Proc priority for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if 3 stacks: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &gt; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258425204770.png?v=1" alt="snipe" title="snipe" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Don't let autos snipe </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> proc when using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Stacked damage buffs of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025696958853180.png?v=1" alt="fularrow" title="fularrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1" alt="reckless" title="reckless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofful" title="scriptureofful" kind="icon" /><nowiki> allow you to easily hit hitcap with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> even outside of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1" alt="mds" title="mds" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1" alt="piercing" title="piercing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are your main basics, use them to balance stacks and keep an eye on your threshold cooldowns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Common ability sequences for kills include (adjust order based on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006119102814887957.png?v=1" alt="perfectequilibrium" title="perfectequilibrium" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stack count):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189289623662702.png?v=1" alt="bolg" title="bolg" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1" alt="mds" title="mds" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538450944.png?v=1" alt="piercing" title="piercing" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259033378827.png?v=1" alt="mds" title="mds" kind="icon" /></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="tuskas" title="tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (helpful for building adren)</nowiki></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
